title: 开饭撤场

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: One metronome on rehearsal table at bottom center, X left, N right. Both rehearse counting, turn to scent of rice, lift one modest white rice bowl each from below crop, exit sideways after each other. Hold on empty stage with swinging metronome; the two peek back empty-handed and return to rehearsal.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw X left and N right, counting with mouths open and right index fingers raised; left hands rest visibly beside the single metronome on the bottom-center rehearsal table. 2) 0.45 s: Both stop counting, turn their eyes and noses toward rice-scent curls rising beside their hips, and lower both hands toward the bottom crop. 3) 0.85 s: Each lifts one modest white rice bowl through the bottom crop, supporting its sides with both visible hands and watching the rice. 4) 1.25 s: X sidesteps left with the bowl level in both hands; N watches X while holding the second bowl at chest height. 5) 1.65 s: X and X's bowl are fully offscreen left; N follows the departure by sidestepping through the right edge, carrying the second bowl in both hands. 6) 2.05–3.05 s: Hold the empty stage and bottom-center table, with the single metronome's pendulum swinging. 7) 3.25 s: X peeks around the left edge and N around the right edge, each showing both empty hands beside their face and looking toward the metronome. 8) 3.80 s: Both step into their original positions, lower their visible empty hands beside the table, and look toward the metronome. 9) 4.65 s: Both resume counting with mouths opening and right index fingers halfway raised, left hands resting beside the table, ready to complete the lift into pose one.
Continuity: Use a fixed camera for a 4.8-second loop, keep the table and metronome base fixed while its pendulum swings, carry both bowls fully offscreen, and connect the distinct ninth pose smoothly to the first. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. B = 0.45 s: Both stop counting, turn their eyes and noses toward rice-scent curls rising beside their hips, and lower both hands toward the bottom crop.
C = 0.85 s: Each lifts one modest white rice bowl through the bottom crop, supporting its sides with both visible hands and watching the rice.
